name: Shine Fashions (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2019, Shine Fashions Ltd is in the business of import and trading of various types of fabrics and textile raw materials[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company does importing, supplying and trading of non-interlinking fabrics, woven fusible interlinings, microdot fusible interlinings. Company took over the business of proprietorship firm AM Fabrics on 30th September, 2019

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 83.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 38.1%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 73.4 days to 45.4 days
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -3.33%
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
